summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on April 23, 2026. Shareholders approved routine items including adoption of statutory annual accounts, reappointment of directors, extension of authorizations to issue shares and limit pre-emption rights, approval of a new Long-Term Incentive Plan, and an amendment to the articles of association. This is a routine meeting notice reporting standard governance approvals applicable to a Dutch foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No event-driven, M&A, or corporate action is present.
